content:
I'm scanning the RingTheory sections of mathlib for facts about integral dependence and integral closures of ideals, and the coverage seems a bit uneven. Before trying to fill some of this in for my own use, I should ask whether has an existing PR or repository that might already have some such material.

To give an example of what I need, consider the first few chapters of Swanson-Huneke, Integral Closure of Ideals, Rings, and Modules. There is of course heavy overlap with the Stacks Project.
